description: Transients in transmission lines connected with DFIG based Wind Farms (Dataset) is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Pallav Bera, Vajendra Kumar (Western Kentucky University). This data set consists of 3-phase currents of faults and other transient cases for transmission lines connected with DFIG-based Wind Farms. PSCAD/EMTDC software is used for the simulation of the faults and other transients. DFIG-based wind farms are becoming more and more grid-integrated. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2022. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
